title: [IMP-2] Exact bytes covered by `accessSig`, `billingSig` and the envelope `id` are undefined
description: Review finding IMP-2: Exact bytes covered by `accessSig`, `billingSig` and the envelope `id` are undefined (lens IMP). Location: spec/05-messaging.md:181-206; spec/13-encoding.md:21, :27 (not :85, :91). Fix: The `accessSig` input and the circular `id` ("CID of the canonical outer envelope", 05:196, against 13:9 "Agora computes no canonical form") are real gaps. `billingSig` is partly settled already: 13:27 lists "the `accessKeyAnnouncement` countersignature" among objects "stored, served and forwarded as its encoded envelope with `sig` present". That makes the announcement a typed envelope whose `body` is signed per §13.1.1, so `billingSig` = that envelope's `sig` entry by the billing DID. Still undefined: the announcement's own signature by the previous epoch access key. That key is not a DID, so §13.1.1's DID-URL `kid` cannot name it. Define it as a raw Ed25519 signature over the announcement `body` bytes with a domain-separation prefix. Full text: notes/review/IMP-verified.md and notes/review/IMP.md.
